posts.title: Disassembly
posts.description: The other day I was thinking about learning styles. I often think about learning styles, since my own personal learning style is less than conventional. I was in smart kid classes, and I did smart kid things. I was not a smart kid, but I was smart enough to know that I was not smart in the effortless polymath way that a lot of smart kids are smart. I was, and am, very jealous of that kind of intel

posts.description: Here's a sketch of something that could be a bigger something. It's always parts like this that I think are going to be like the key melodic feature of a song, but then I just bury it in four other guitar parts. Maybe I should get better at EQing. What a concept.
